entries.claim: Task 6 explicitly makes `/cad-suggest` silent when no bracket has `duration_ms`, so it does not deliver the required `unrecorded` result for a render where every close lacks the worker wall clock.
entries.failure_scenario: Run `/cad-suggest` on a phase containing one or more brackets, all without `duration_ms` (the normal pre-v3.7.2 record shape). The task requires no receipt at all, whereas ROADMAP Phase 1 success criterion 4 and CONTEXT AC5 require `/cad-suggest` to say `unrecorded`, rather than `0`, for a bracket whose close carried no wall clock. Thus MSR-05 remains unmet for the all-unrecorded case despite the proposed tests passing.
